items.t: Bumble cozies up to Alix Earle in attempt to convert Gen Zers
items.sum: The social-forward campaign comes just weeks after the app’s parent company announced it is to be acquired for $1.3 billion following revenue and user declines.

items.t: Citigroup Maintains Neutral on Bumble, Raises Price Target to $6.05
items.sum: Citigroup analyst Jamesmichael Sherman-Lewis maintains Bumble (NASDAQ:BMBL) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $3.2 to $6.05.

items.t: Bumble (BMBL) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Take Private Deal Focus
items.sum: Bumble’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from about US$4.18 to US$3.84 per share, which recalibrates how analysts frame the potential equity value as the agreed US$6.05 cash offer sits in the background. items.t: What Bumble Buyers Were Betting On
items.sum: Bumble investors faced clashing narratives at the outset, from one analysis arguing safety features and AI tools could support engagement to another warning the app had lost its edge in a tiring online dating market.
